title: Photothermal activity in cancer therapy and antimicrobial properties of green gold nanoparticles from winery waste
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20039-20050
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01505K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lucia Mergola, André F. Moreira, Sónia P. Miguel, Paula Coutinho, Christian Demitri, Antonio Serra, Daniela Manno, Alessandro Buccolieri, Roberta Del Sole
Green gold nanoparticles, obtained from winery waste, showed good photothermal activity after NIR laser irradiation and their application in the reduction of breast cancer cells and bacteria viability was successfully demonstrated.
